meta.title: Oh! — a synth and a sample organizer
meta.description: Oh! makes music software: Oh a Synth, a browser-playable polysynth inspired by the 80s, and Oh a Comber, a sample library organizer.

hero.line: Two music tools from one person who makes records with them: a polysynth inspired by the classic sounds of the 80s that runs in your browser, and a sample organizer for the library you already have.

synth.headline: Six voices, inspired by the 80s.
synth.body: Exact DCO tuning, a self-oscillating ladder filter, one honest ADSR, and the chorus that made the original famous. The whole signal path runs per-sample in your browser — no download, no signup.
synth.mediaCaption: Slot: the Oh a Synth panel — STRINGS 1 loaded, CHORUS I lit (native app screenshot, assets/img/synth-hero.png)

comber.headline: Every sample you own, findable.
comber.body: Oh a Comber scans your sample folders where they sit and turns them into a searchable, filterable library. Preview with waveforms, then drag the real file straight onto a track. It never moves or renames anything.
comber.mediaCaption: Slot: the Oh a Comber library after a scan (app screenshot, assets/img/comber-after.png)

maker.heading: Who makes this
maker.body: Oh! is Nate Mueller — designer, developer, and the first user of everything here. Records music as Oacoma.
